title: Oolite
summary: O'OLITE, noun [Gr. an egg, and stone, from its resemblance to the roes of fish.] Egg-stone, a variety of concreted carbonate of lime; oviform limestone.

inlines.v: O'OLITE, noun [Gr. an egg, and stone, from its resemblance to the roes of fish.] Egg-stone, a variety of concreted carbonate of lime; oviform limestone.
